versions.changelog:
- Major cleanup: removed unused demo and documentation directories to streamline the repository.
- Added a .clawhubignore file for improved file management.
- No changes to the skill’s core functionality or behavior.
- Users will experience a simpler, lighter codebase with only essential files retained.

- Clarified strict workflow and file structure for generating multi-screen wireframe deliverables with Vue 3 Global Build, emphasizing no build or Node dependency in final outputs.
- Updated compatibility and upgrade rules: v1 (React/JSX) and v2 (Vue-global) projects are strictly separated, with clear identification and migration instructions.
- Detailed project format constraints, screen definition requirements, and component registration order for Vue 3 Global.
- Expanded DOM protocols for stable annotation and modification, specifying naming and data-key standards.
- Outlined clear boundaries: only operate in copied target directories, never require directory selection or install steps from end users.
- Improved documentation on content completeness, layout standards, and annotation workflows.
- Added explicit requirements for consistency and error isolation across screens, file structure, runtime, and export verification.
